d: Anant Singh Daughter Wedding: ab aakhir aisa kya huaa... jo bihar ke bahubli vidhayak anant sinh ke armanon par pani phirta dikhaee de raha hai... jis shadi ko yadgar banane ke lie mahinon se taiyariyan chal rahi thin... jahan karib 4 lakh mehmanon ke aane ka anuman hai... 16 VVIP mehmanon ke lie helikoptar se pahunchne ka intjam tha... aur mehmanon ke manoranjan ke lie ghurdaur pratiyogita tak rakhi gaee thi... vahan achanak aisa kya ho gaya ki puri vyavastha hi bigarti najar aa rahi hai...aakhir kyon helikoptar ki Landing se lekar ghurdaur tak par sankat mandrane laga hai... aur kya 25…
